name: Sync Wiki and Improve CI Performance

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      message:
        description: 'Message for the commit'
        required: true
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'current/docs/**'

jobs:
  sync-wiki:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Install Gradle Wrapper
        run: ./gradlew wrapper --gradle-version=7.0.2

      - name: Build and sync wiki
        run: ./gradlew :docs:buildWiki --no-daemon

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add current/docs/wiki
          git commit -m "${{ github.event.inputs.message }}"
          git push origin main

  fix-ci-performance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Install Gradle Wrapper
        run: ./gradlew wrapper --gradle-version=7.0.2

      - name: Apply CI performance fixes
        run: ./gradlew clean build --no-daemon

  consolidate-test-workflows:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Install Gradle Wrapper
        run: ./gradlew wrapper --gradle-version=7.0.2

      - name: Consolidate and fix test workflows
        run: ./gradlew test --tests ':current:test' --no-daemon

  docker-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Install Gradle Wrapper
        run: ./gradlew wrapper --gradle-version=7.0.2

      - name: Publish Docker image
        run: ./gradlew dockerPublish --no-daemon

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        id: create_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false
          body: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}

  prepare-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Install Gradle Wrapper
        run: ./gradlew wrapper --gradle-version=7.0.2

      - name: Prepare release
        run: ./gradlew prepareRelease --no-daemon

  remove-check-version-bump-sh:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Remove check-version-bump.sh hook
        run: rm .git/hooks/pre-commit
